name: io.gamedock.sdk.ads.core.ui.GamedockAdsActivity
description: When Gamedock Ads is asked to show a full-screen ad, this Activity displays image, web, or video interstitials and video or VAST rewarded ads. It tells the app when a rewarded video has been completed and its reward earned.
disableEffect: Blocking it stops these Gamedock Ads from opening; users will not receive rewards for watching rewarded ads.
